mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances with UNRATE decline >0.2pp (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, increasing corporate profit visibility and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates supply chain constraints, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 100,000 monthly adds signals sustained job market expansion, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of months with PAYEMS > 100,000 (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation acceleration exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals persistent inflation, prompting Fed tightening expectations and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with CPIAUCSL rise >0.3pp (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate decline and payroll growth indicate labor market strength, increasing consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of falling UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Demand contraction regime (GDPC1 annualized growth < 0.5%) indicates weak economic activity, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with GDPC1 growth < 0.5% annualized (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
